issues.actual: Independently rebuilt the exact new_defs/new_theorems text as Molt/ZZZVerifyW4.lean (written to `k + 1` throughout, as the design's own outline says to) against the live repo with the pinned toolchain (leanprover/lean4:v4.30.0-rc2, via /etheron-pod/toolchains/lake.sh build Molt.ZZZVerifyW4). issues.claim: 'the 21 explicit arguments and their order were verified against the live source' (goal_statement and proof_sketch for sync_induction_full_chain)
issues.actual: Molt.sync_rule_mem (Molt/ClientRule.lean:284-317, read directly) takes 22 explicit hypothesis arguments after its implicits: hn, hEUF, hHash, hVPrev, hTipPrev, hRecPrev, hLongPrev, hAnchor, hCadence, hA, hA', hBudget, hVal, hVal', hTipS, hTipS', hRecent, hRecent', hLong, hLong', hLe, hB. The design's call list supplies exactly these 22 in exactly this order (verified by rebuilding); '21' undercounts by one (apparently not counting hn separately).
issues.fix: Say '22 explicit arguments (hn plus 21 more)' or just '22'; purely a labeling nit, the argument list itself is exactly right and compiles.

confirmed_reuses: Molt.sync_rule_mem (Molt/ClientRule.lean:284) — read in full; signature and proof body match the design's description exactly (binder order hn, hEUF, hHash, hVPrev, hTipPrev, hRecPrev, hLongPrev, hAnchor, hCadence, hA, hA', hBudget, hVal, hVal', hTipS, hTipS', hRecent, hRecent', hLong, hLong', hLe, hB; conclusion ∃ i', i' + n < (stripSigs sc').length ∧ blockAt? (stripSigs sc') i' = some B). It is a public, non-private top-level theorem inside `namespace Molt`, already guarded in Molt/Axioms.lean's axiom family at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] indirectly via the theorems that call it (sync_rule_mem itself is not directly guarded, but its own dependencies keyrot_recent_tip_ancestor_mem_anchored / client_refresh_rule / deep_block_span are the standard axiom set). The design's exact 22-argument call to it, instantiated once per induction step with scPrev := c k, sc := c (k+1), sc' := R (k+1), A := a k, B := a (k+1), was independently rebuilt against the live repo (Molt/ZZZVerifyW4.lean, deleted after verification) and compiled with zero sorry/errors, reproducing the design's claimed unification of every implicit (now, t, Δ, sTip, sTip', A, B, sc, sc') without conflict.

List.IsPrefix.mem (Lean core, Init/Data/List/Sublist.lean:816) — used as `(d.hPrefix k).mem ih` inside SyncInductionData.invariant; compiles as claimed, present and unprotected in the pinned v4.30.0-rc2 toolchain.

List.mem_of_getElem? (Lean core, Init/Data/List/Lemmas.lean:479) — used inside the new `mem_of_blockAt?` helper (`unfold blockAt? at hAt; exact List.mem_of_getElem? hAt`); compiles as claimed, axiom footprint [propext] exactly as predicted.

Molt.Verifier.stripSigs, Molt.Protocol.Chain (abbrev for MoltPetit.Model.Chain) and Molt.ClientRule's ambient definitions (blockAt?, badSlotsIn, badKeyrot, faultBudget, KeyStealingEUFCMA, SignedHashInjective, KeyStealingSigned, validSignedChainK', SigningLog) — all resolve inside `namespace Molt` via the single `import Molt.ClientRule`, exactly as the design claims (no MoltPetit.Model import needed); confirmed by the independent build succeeding with that one import.
ordering_notes: No blocking predecessors: the design depends only on Molt.sync_rule_mem, Molt.ClientRule, and Lean-core List lemmas, all already present on the current branch (feature/key-rotation-sound). The stated dependency on W2 is correctly marked soft/hard=false — SyncInductionData and its .invariant proof are independent of W2's cert_sync_rule and were confirmed (by rebuild) to type-check and axiom-guard cleanly with only Molt.ClientRule imported. W4 can be implemented in any order relative to W2/W1/W5; it only needs to land before any future item that wants to instantiate SyncInductionData at a certificate or lockstep presentation (per 'enables').
revised_effort: 1 session, likely on the low end of that — the full four declarations were independently reproduced from the design's new_defs/new_theorems/proof_sketch text verbatim (not just eyeballed) and compiled clean on the first try against the live repo, with axiom footprints matching the design's claims exactly ('does not depend on any axioms' for SyncInductionData.invariant, [propext] for mem_of_blockAt?, [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] for sync_induction_full_chain). Remaining work is genuinely just the bookkeeping the design describes: paste into two new files with docstrings, add two Molt.lean import lines, write the AxiomsSyncInduction.lean guard file with the exact emitted #print axioms messages (confirmed above), and run one lake build Molt / nix run .#verify-lean pass. No proof engineering risk remains open.
